# Gilbert Blythe & Shirley

- [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) — Rival of — [Shirley](../character/shirley.md) — academic rivals in schoolwork · since v1  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P36](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0036)</sub>

## Shared scenes

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) share a dramatic goodbye after Mrs. [Barry](../character/barry.md) forbids [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) from playing with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md). Afterwards, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) decides to return to school, where she is warmly welcomed by her classmates, exchanges secret notes with [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md), and enters a fierce academic rivalry with [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md).
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P0](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0000), [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P16](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0016), [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P28](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0028), [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P36](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0036)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) wins the Avery Scholarship while [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) wins the medal. After celebrating commencement with [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md), [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), and [Aunt Josephine](../character/josephine-barry.md), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), re-engaging with [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md), noticing Matthew's failing health, and sharing a tender, memorable evening walk with [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md).
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXXVI. The Glory and the Dream

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXVI. The Glory and the Dream P7](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0007), [v1 CHAPTER XXXVI. The Glory and the Dream P12](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0012), [v1 CHAPTER XXXVI. The Glory and the Dream P17](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0017), [v1 CHAPTER XXXVI. The Glory and the Dream P41](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0041)_

> As wedding preparations for Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) continue, [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md) and [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md) express their excitement about moving to [Boston](../codex/places.md#boston). Meanwhile, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) reflects on romance with [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and later stumbles upon [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) and [Fred Wright](../character/fred-wright.md) sharing an intimate moment. [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) later visits [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) to confide her engagement to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), leading [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to ponder her own future dreams of love.
>
> — v2 · XXIX Poetry and Prose

_Sources: [v2 XXIX Poetry and Prose P2](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0002), [v2 XXIX Poetry and Prose P5](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0005), [v2 XXIX Poetry and Prose P11](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0011), [v2 XXIX Poetry and Prose P15](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0015)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) help prepare for Miss Lavendar's wedding at [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) before the intimate ceremony takes place in the garden as the sun breaks through the clouds. After seeing the newly married couple off at the station, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md) return to tidy up the house, where [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) later shares a quiet, subtly meaningful moment with [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) before they leave.
>
> — v2 · XXX A Wedding at the Stone House

_Sources: [v2 XXX A Wedding at the Stone House P11](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0011), [v2 XXX A Wedding at the Stone House P29](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0029), [v2 XXX A Wedding at the Stone House P30](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0030), [v2 XXX A Wedding at the Stone House P40](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0040)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) from [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) and is shocked to learn from [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) and Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) that [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) is critically ill with typhoid fever. She spends a grief-stricken night realizing her deep love for [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) and fearing for his life. At dawn, she speaks with [Pacifique](../character/pacifique.md), who tells her that [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) passed the crisis and will recover.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XL A Book of Revelation

_Sources: [v3 ch.Revelation P6](../source/v03-c40.md#nw-v03-c40-p0006), [v3 ch.Revelation P9](../source/v03-c40.md#nw-v03-c40-p0009), [v3 ch.Revelation P16](../source/v03-c40.md#nw-v03-c40-p0016), [v3 ch.Revelation P25](../source/v03-c40.md#nw-v03-c40-p0025)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) discusses her wedding guest list and plans with Mrs. Rachel [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md). Friends and guests, including [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md), [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md) the [Fourth](../character/fourth.md), and [Philippa Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md), arrive at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) ahead of the ceremony, bringing news and gifts like Miss Patty's china dogs. On the eve of her wedding, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) visits Matthew's grave and walks home with [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), reminiscing about their past together.
>
> — v4 · CHAPTER 3 THE LAND OF DREAMS AMONG

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) wakes up on her wedding day at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) and reflects on her time in her childhood room. Friends and family gather for the wedding ceremony in the orchard, after which [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) depart on the train for [Glen](../codex/places.md#glen) St. Mary.
